data.long_meaning: From the Greek name 'Ioannes', derived from the Hebrew name 'Yohanan'. The name Yannis means 'God is gracious'. In the New Testament, John the Baptist is referred to as Yannis. in_hebrew.name: יאניס
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא חנון, אלוהים הראה חסדו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יאניס הוא צורה עברית של השם היווני 'יואניס', שמקורו בשם העברי 'יוֹחָנָן' (יוחנן), שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא חנון' או 'אלוהים הראה חסדו'. השם יאניס הוא שם נפוץ בקרב הנוצרים והוא נמצא גם בברית החדשה.

in_greek.name: Γιάννης
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός είναι χαριτωμένος, Θεός ελεήμων
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιάννης είναι η ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος 'יוֹחָנָן' (יוחנן), που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι χαριτωμένος' ή 'Θεός ελεήμων'. Το όνομα Γιάννης ήταν κοινό στην αρχαία Ελλάδα και αναφέρεται και στη Καινή Διαθήκη ως το όνομα του Ιωάννη Βαπτιστή και του Ιωάννη του Αποστόλου.

in_latin.name: Ioannis
in_latin.meaning: Deus est misericors, Deus gratia plena
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Ioannis ex hebraeo nomine 'יוֹחָנָן' (yôḥānān) derivatur, quod significat 'Deus est misericors' vel 'Deus gratia plena'. Nomen Ioannis in Ecclesia primitiva Christiana frequenter invenitur et in Novum Testamentum ut nomen Ioannis Baptistae et Ioannis Apostoli refertur.

in_english.name: Yannis
in_english.meaning: God is gracious, God has shown favor
in_english.long_meaning: The name Yannis is derived from the Hebrew name 'יוֹחָנָן' (yôḥānān), which means 'God is gracious' or 'God has shown favor'. The name Yannis is commonly used among Christians and is found in the New Testament as the name of John the Baptist and John the Apostle. It symbolizes divine favor and mercy, reflecting a deep spiritual significance in Christian tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yannis holds significant cultural importance in Greece and many other Eastern European countries. It is a common name, ranking among the top 10 most popular names in some regions. Yannis is often used as a nickname for Jean, Giovanni, and Ivan, as well as being used as a standalone name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Yannis holds great spiritual significance for Christians. It is a reminder of the grace and mercy of God. In the New Testament, John the Baptist is described as a forerunner of Christ, preparing the way for His coming. By bearing the name Yannis, one is reminded to live a life focused on following God's will and spreading His message of love and grace to others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yannis, a Greek variant of John, represents divine grace and God's merciful love. The name signifies the strength and power of God in one's life. It is a reminder of the promise that God is always with us, guiding and protecting us.

biblical_reference.note: The name Yannis is associated with John the Baptist and John the Apostle in the New Testament.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Yannis was a common name in ancient Greece. The name Yannis carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Yannis was a common name for both men and women in ancient Greece, derived from the Greek god Zeus.

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern usage, Yannis is a common name in Greece, but it is rare in other countries. It is used as a given name for both men and women. Yannis is also used as a nickname for Ioannis (John) and other Greek names that begin with the letter Y. In social media and email addresses, Yannis is often used as a shortened form of Ioannis or other Greek names.
